scenes.text: The coldest place we have ever found is not in deep space.
It is a cloud of gas 5,000 light years away, called the Boomerang Nebula.
It sits at one degree above absolute zero.
That is colder than the empty space around it.
It is colder than the light left over from the Big Bang.
